name: Setagaya-Daita
tagline: Shinjuku in 12 minutes and Shibuya in 14 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Setagaya City, where Odakyu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 27 minutes to Otemachi, 12 minutes to Shinjuku, 14 minutes to Shibuya and 34 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 42.8 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 15.4 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 42.8 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 29.8 m to 45.2 m, a difference of 15.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. The station itself is inside the projected area, but few of the points around it are. Compared with other stations in the 23 wards, the flood projection here is on the small side.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 26 clinics and 14 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 文寿会福原病院, about 15 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is アマノ動物病院, about 17 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Odakyu Odawara Line.
congestion: Odakyu Odawara Line runs at 150% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 世田谷代田→下北沢, which includes this station. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 2LDK ¥240,000 to ¥250,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the lowest in the 23 wards. What holds the figure down: only one line, the {line}, serving the station. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Setagaya-Daita is ahead on how easy the shopping is, and little else separates the two.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Setagaya-Daita. Setagaya-Daita adds the Odakyu Odawara Line; Shindaita adds the Keio Inokashira Line. Which is faster depends on where you are going: Setagaya-Daita is 5 minutes quicker to Tokyo, Shindaita is 5 minutes quicker to Shibuya. On how easy the shopping is, Setagaya-Daita comes out ahead. Within about 13 minutes' walk, Setagaya-Daita has 6 supermarkets (まいばすけっと and 信濃屋 and others) and Shindaita has 4.

neighbours.lead: For how close the centre is, Shimo-Kitazawa; for quiet, Setagaya-Daita.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Setagaya-Daita. Both have the Odakyu Odawara Line. Shimo-Kitazawa also has the Keio Inokashira Line, which Setagaya-Daita does not. Shimo-Kitazawa is at least 6 minutes quicker to Shinagawa and Shibuya. On quiet, though, Setagaya-Daita comes out ahead.

goodFor: People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: People who want another route when service is suspended
noiseSources: 環七通り (3 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. Traffic on it never stops

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Odakyu Odawara Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning trains are very crowded: this station sits on the busiest stretch of the Odakyu Odawara Line.
